name: Rocket Money OG social card by rocketmoney.com
description: A 1200×630 share card built on a quiet warm-gray canvas with a hard left/right split: a text lockup on the left, a cropped device hero on the right. Hierarchy is pure scale — red wordmark, then a two-line near-black display headline, then three gray bullets — while all the colour energy (crimson gradient header, purple chart, green checkmarks) is pushed into the phone screen. The ~30° rotated phone bleeding off the top and bottom edges gives the card depth and motion without any background decoration.
